rule.alternative_not_taken: gate the strict V10 figure as well (the first pass): strict V10 is 20/26 = 0.769 on the widened denominator, so G2 would be FAIL by construction on A1 and on DEV-CHECK whatever the engine does
rule.basis: plan §10 amendment 4d: 'The DEV_AUTO_CONFIRMED recipes: every V10/native bend, both flange sides REQUIRED, exclusions only through a pre-written per-feature UNSUPPORTED rule. Compile failures stay in the denominators, and at least 80% of authorized STEPs must compile.' The floor applies to the frozen DEV_AUTO_CONFIRMED recipes (E1-DEV-POLICY-1: the V10/native union, pieces of one fold merged, rule-declared features excluded), i.e. the recipes the evaluation runs on. The strict single-source V10 figure is called 'the amendment-4d figure' only in E1's ENGINE_COMPILE.md §10; it is reported next to the gate as a diagnostic
rule.decided: 2026-10-17, E4b freeze fix pass, before A1; flagged for owner confirmation before the anchor is published
